name: WindowFrame
purpose: Root element of one window. Titled is the full app window (main and settings) with a TitleBar under it. Frameless is the borderless quick-add capture card, desktop only. Fills its window and holds the title bar, body and overlays.

values.when: h-screen w-screen, flex column, bg-surface-1, text-content-1, overflow hidden. Used by the main and settings windows. Window size (1180x760 default, 820x640 narrow, Settings 1180x760 at 0,0) is window configuration, not a variant.
rounded-panel, 1px border, w-screen, no TitleBar, light surface (dark grey in dark theme). Used only by the capture bar (desktop only).

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Frameless only. Handles Enter, Escape and Tab for the whole capture bar.

props.name: children
props.description: Titled: TitleBar and body row (PaneGroup) with overlays. Frameless: the capture bar rows.

role: none (document root; each desktop window is its own document)
keyboard: Frameless: root onKeyDown handles Enter, Escape and Tab for the whole bar. Titled: none.
platform: Desktop: each window is a real OS window; main and settings are native windows; capture is a separate frameless window. Web: no window chrome from the app; main is the app root page; Settings is a route, not a window; no capture bar.
open: Web presentation of Settings (route or dialog) is undecided. Capture bar is desktop-only and drops out of the web build. Merge: A's kind main and kind settings collapse into titled (B): both render the same frame (surface-1, full window); Settings identity sits in its content. A's name Window is dropped for WindowFrame. A's settings frame has no recorded fill, so surface-1 is assumed for it (confirm).
